name: Cubers East India Open 2016

venue.name: Sarada Prasad Institution, Ultadanga, Kolkata
venue.address: 108/18, Bidhan Nagar Road, Ultadanga Main Road, Kolkata - 700067

information: All information and registration details will be up on the Cubers East India Company website by December 11, 2015, please wait for the site to update. Once the site is updated, PLEASE go through all the information given on the website, before you register and before mailing us with your questions. Online registrations begin on December 12, 2015 at 00:00:01 hrs and end on January 7, 2016 at 23:59:59 hrs. Registrations at the venue on spot will be charged extra and will be limited, hence we encourage all participants to register online.
